assessments.reasoning: I reopened the retained original PDF and verified its whole-file digest and all three raw intervals. The page object and encoded streams anchor physical page 15. The semantic evidence comes from the two sentences in the decoded scope clause. The first assigns the conceptual framework a specific purpose in other parts of the series, covering both SQL syntax and what follows from executing statements. The second establishes that other parts use Part 1's terminology and notation, but leaves their specific purpose open. The claim extends the first sentence's purpose to all three contributions.

challenge.method: Could both scope sentences be true if another part used the terminology and notation for a purpose other than specifying syntax or execution results?
challenge.results: Yes. Only the framework carries the explicit purpose qualification. The passage supports a narrower description of the division of work and gives no individual statement requirement. The broader reading remains unestablished.

limitations: This is a documented description of the multipart standard's organization using the public Framework preview. It establishes no detailed requirement for any SQL statement.
The descriptive finding is limited to the title and scope of the June 2023 public preview.
